description: This file defines a Koin module for dependency injection related to synchronization features in the app, including creation of a SyncScope and registration of backend provider, remote actions processor, and notes synchronizer.

classes.name: SyncScope
classes.description: A class that implements CoroutineScope by delegation, initialized with a provided CoroutineScope instance.

methods.name: SyncScope
methods.description: Constructor for SyncScope that delegates CoroutineScope implementation to the provided scope.
